description: Pins the cluster_id/pool_id-required rejections (checked in order) and the confirmed PUT with a minimal count body. The confirm-required text diverges (see report), so that case is reported, not pinned. A response that is not a JSON object must fail rather than yield a zeroed pool; the bare-array shape of that case is withheld because Python still fabricates a success from it (see report).
